name: Pick a Slide [Backrooms]
desc:
Pick a slide! 🎈

Pick the right one, and you'll move forward through the backrooms. But if you pick the wrong one, it will send you to your doom! 😱

The winning slide is decided by players like you by voting. (The first slide you choose for each question counts as your vote)

Your vote counts and determines the course of the game! 😲 

regnat populus!
